2003.method_note: 2003 crop values are half-year; animal/non-farm are 30-day. Weekly wage conversion remains an explicit project harmonization factor and is reported in methodology_assumptions.csv. Lease and pension/remittance amounts are unsupported and stay blank as individual KPIs.

2013.method_note: 2013 Block 4 wage/salary earnings refer to the six-month visit reference period (July-December 2012 in Visit 1; January-June 2013 in Visit 2), so divide by 6. Crop values are also half-year; animal/non-farm values are last 30 days. Lease and pension/remittance amount KPIs are unsupported by the supplied 2013 source and remain blank.

2019.method_note: 2019 Block 3 wages, pension/remittances, and leased-out-land rent are collected for the six-month visit reference period (July-December 2018 or January-June 2019), so divide by 6. Crop values are half-year; animal/non-farm values are last 30 days.
